title: Build a catalog of data collaborations
summary: Develop a trusted catalog where people can discover concrete data projects and organizations can eventually propose work for review.
workAvailable: Classify opportunities by domain, skills, participation model, and readiness
Identify missing, overlapping, and potentially redundant initiatives
Design a reviewed submission path for teams, labs, and organizations
caveats: Direct submissions are not available yet.
Every published opportunity still requires editorial verification and clear attribution.

title: Map payroll concepts across organizations
attribution: This student project began at IES N.º 7 before Conjecture 56 was created. That experience helped shape Conjecture 56's approach to educational and institutional collaboration.
summary: Create a reproducible, human-reviewed crosswalk between payroll concepts used by different public organizations.
workAvailable: Define the canonical data contract and semantic relationship vocabulary
Normalize source spreadsheets through organization-specific adapters
Build and evaluate an explainable candidate-ranking baseline
caveats: The current repository and proposal are not public contribution entry points.
Students propose and evaluate mappings; domain specialists retain final authority.
Payroll records require strict privacy controls and authorized data access.

title: Govern shared AI API access
summary: Provide teams with individually governed model access while keeping upstream credentials protected.
workAvailable: Deployed Bifrost virtual keys with per-key and per-model quotas
Added self-service usage and limit inspection
Kept provider credentials server-side and documented secure client onboarding
caveats: Access is provisioned deliberately rather than through public self-registration.
Provider limits remain authoritative when they are stricter than local quotas.

title: Measure the Spanish–English LLM gap under prompting
summary: Measure the performance gap between Spanish and English in small open language models under zero-shot prompting, using the ODESIA Leaderboard (UNED) controlled bilingual benchmark. Planned as an applied research project to propose at UCSE.
workAvailable: Register on the ODESIA Leaderboard and download the bilingual task datasets it distributes
Design zero-shot and few-shot prompts, starting with the four public Extended Tasks
Run small open models (<8B) through the Conjecture 56 gateway and record predictions
Submit EvALL-format predictions and read the calibrated Spanish–English gap per task
Publish the prompting-mode gap analysis as an open applied research report
caveats: Proposed as an applied research project at Universidad Católica de Salta (UCSE); no manual data creation is required because every dataset is an existing annotated benchmark.
Core Task test labels stay private at UNED; confirm how prompting-mode systems are categorized before extending beyond the Extended Tasks.
Fine-tuning variants can use free Kaggle or Colab GPU tiers; zero-shot inference runs on the Conjecture 56 gateway.

title: Student AI Access Pilot Program
summary: Give students managed access to language models when they actively contribute to a project listed by Conjecture 56.
workAvailable: Provisioned an individual virtual key for each participating student
Applied bounded model, daily, monthly, and request-rate limits
Enabled students to inspect their own usage without exposing other keys
caveats: The program currently serves participating students from Prácticas Profesionalizantes III at IES N.º 7 and Inteligencia Artificial at UCSE.
Course enrollment alone does not grant access; students must contribute to a project listed by Conjecture 56.
Keys are individual, scoped, monitored, and revocable.

title: Refresh the INDEC provider
summary: Extend the existing DBnomics INDEC provider with a current official statistical series from API-INDEC.
workAvailable: Confirm the update path with DBnomics maintainers
Add one bounded API-INDEC dataset such as the basic food and total basket series
Preserve source metadata and validate the converted time series
caveats: Coordinate before implementation because the source-data pipeline is newer than the published provider data.
API-INDEC is a beta service that requires an account and attribution to INDEC.
Do not create a duplicate INDEC provider.

title: Strengthen humanitarian GeoAI
summary: Improve fAIr, HOT's open platform for AI-assisted humanitarian mapping with human validation.
workAvailable: Agree on one uncovered backend area from the open testing initiative
Add focused Django API or model tests
Document local execution and coverage results
caveats: Agree on the exact test slice with maintainers because the issue supports multiple contributors.
Imagery and OpenStreetMap-derived labels have separate licensing requirements.
The contribution guide prohibits AI tools on issues labeled good first issue.

title: Estimate public transport emissions
summary: Build a reproducible analysis of public-transport emissions from an agreed GTFS feed.
workAvailable: Select one GTFS feed with Trufi
Produce route and trip emissions tables with gtfs2emis
Document fleet assumptions, validation results, and methodology
caveats: Confirm the feed, repository, and acceptance criteria before starting.
OpenStreetMap-derived data requires ODbL attribution and share-alike compliance.
Volunteers must accept the Trufi code of conduct.

title: Detect revised air-quality measurements
summary: Help detect measurements that change after ingestion without silently overwriting canonical observations.
workAvailable: Agree on revision semantics with maintainers
Create a focused design and test spike
Implement approved detection, diagnostics, and integration tests
caveats: Maintainers have not finalized storage semantics, so approval is required before implementation.
The openaq-ingestor repository does not currently expose a license file; clarify contribution terms first.
OpenAQ data carries attribution and provider-specific terms.

title: Document nutrition-table inference
summary: Create a reproducible Robotoff notebook and focused guide for nutrition-table detection workflows.
workAvailable: Agree on a narrow nutrition-table scope for issue 1367
Cover single-image and directory inference workflows
Add validation instructions and focused documentation
caveats: Confirm the narrowed scope because the full issue covers too many components for one work unit.
Local development requires Git LFS and a Docker-backed database environment.
Robotoff is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only.

title: Map astronomical alert density
summary: Build and test bounded HEALPix aggregates that show recent astronomical alert density.
workAvailable: Confirm the target repository and output schema for issue 1143
Compute static alert-density aggregates for 24, 48, and 96 hour windows
Add focused tests and document required sample data
caveats: Confirm ownership because the issue may span broker, statistics, and portal repositories.
The complete development environment includes Spark, Kafka, HBase, and large container images.
Astronomy expertise may be needed to validate scientific semantics.

title: Correct weather input units
summary: Improve Quartz solar forecasts by making Open-Meteo variable mapping and units explicit and testable.
workAvailable: Request assignment and confirm the scope of issue 375
Correct temperature, wind, and precipitation units
Replace positional mapping with name-based mapping and add regression tests
caveats: The issue is not labeled contributions-welcome, so obtain assignment before coding.
Longwave-radiation handling remains a maintainer decision.
Contributors remain responsible for understanding and reviewing any AI-assisted work.

title: Pilot an INDEC data import
summary: Propose and implement one missing INDEC table as a provenance-rich Data Commons pilot import.
workAvailable: Check existing coverage and submit an official data request
Map one accepted table to entities and statistical variables
Add a reproducible transformation, fixtures, tests, provenance, and license metadata
caveats: Do not build the import until the official data request is accepted.
A Google Contributor License Agreement is required.
The source dataset must satisfy the Data Commons licensing policy.

title: Map Argentina's transmission grid
summary: Improve open power-grid coverage through a coordinated Argentina mapping and quality-assurance sprint.
workAvailable: Agree on one province or transmission corridor with the MapYourGrid community
Inventory incomplete lines and quality findings using verifiable sources
Publish reviewed OpenStreetMap changesets and a before-and-after quality note
caveats: Register the proposed regional scope through the project community before editing.
Do not copy incompatible maps or restricted infrastructure data.
OpenStreetMap data is governed by the ODbL and local mapping conventions.

title: Filter custom power plants by country
summary: Implement country-aware filtering for custom power-plant inputs in reproducible energy-system models.
workAvailable: Confirm country-key semantics on issue 1352 or a developer call
Add filtering to the power-plant build workflow
Add single-country and multi-country regression fixtures and documentation
caveats: The issue remains unassigned and help-wanted but is older than the current development cycle; reconfirm it before coding.
Code is AGPL-3.0-or-later and pull requests require explicit licensing consent.
Use the project's Snakemake workflow and testing conventions.

title: Restore broken terms trackers
summary: Repair a bounded batch of declarations that no longer track terms or policy documents correctly.
workAvailable: Self-assign three to five selector or structure-change issues
Update URLs and selection rules while preserving prior declarations
Run repeat-fetch validation and submit small reviewable pull requests
caveats: Avoid access-blocked or timeout cases unless maintainers confirm a contributor-fixable approach.
Declarations use EUPL-1.2 and generated versions use ODC-BY 1.0.
Historical declarations must be preserved with correct validity metadata.

title: Refine dataset tag taxonomy
summary: Migrate one agreed dataset-tag family and improve consistency checks and metadata documentation.
workAvailable: Discuss issue 5908 and agree on one migration slice
Update tags across a bounded set of datasets
Add consistency checks and validate generated metadata
caveats: The issue is explicitly marked for discussion; do not perform a blind bulk edit.
Contributors must confirm they have the right to submit all included material.
Code is MIT, while published data and vendored sources have separate licensing terms.

title: Improve Argentine Spanish speech data
summary: Run a coordinated sentence, recording, and validation sprint for Argentine Spanish speech data.
workAvailable: Confirm the locale and release window with the Common Voice community
Contribute and review an agreed number of original or public-domain sentences and clips
Publish contribution counts, provenance, and quality-review methodology
caveats: Coordinate the exact locale and dataset release cutoff before starting.
Submitted text must be original or demonstrably public domain.
Age, consent, and supervision requirements apply to participants.

title: Add Loculus ingest regression tests
summary: Add a narrow regression-test slice for pathogen-sequence ingestion after an upstream tool upgrade escaped existing coverage.
workAvailable: Confirm the narrow test slice with the maintainer on issue 7531
Cover empty input and one repeat-ingest happy path without revisions
Document fixtures and run the relevant integration checks
caveats: The complete issue exceeds a four-week work unit; proceed only with an approved test slice.
The repository is AGPL-3.0 and requires tests for non-trivial code.
Full end-to-end coverage may require heavier Kubernetes infrastructure.

title: Validate telemetry decoder schemas
summary: Prevent incompatible array-valued telemetry fields from reaching SatNOGS ingestion by validating decoder schemas in CI.
workAvailable: Agree on allowed field shapes with maintainers on issue 85
Implement a focused schema validator with valid and invalid fixtures
Run validation in CI and document local contributor usage
caveats: The validation contract is not specified yet; obtain design agreement before implementation.
Contributions require a Developer Certificate of Origin Signed-off-by line.
Contributors must understand and take responsibility for all submitted work.

title: Correct unused-station notice severity
summary: Correct the severity of the GTFS Validator unused-station notice and update its tests and generated documentation.
workAvailable: Claim issue 1348 in GitHub and the contributor Slack
Confirm and implement the target notice severity
Update tests, fixtures, and generated rule documentation
caveats: Announce intent before coding and keep the pull request to one functionality.
The project uses Apache-2.0 and Google Java Style.
Do not substitute nearby issues that already have contributor work in progress.

title: Review CHIP benefit valuation evidence
summary: Reconcile California CHIP populations, services, enrollment denominators, and fiscal periods before model values are changed.
workAvailable: Build a source and evidence matrix from official program documents
Test the valuation alternatives described in issue 10155
Publish reproducible calculations, limitations, and a recommended decision rule
caveats: The bounded contribution is evidence and recommendation, not a unilateral model change.
Official citations and consistent annual units are essential.
The repository is AGPL-3.0 and subsequent model changes require tests and changelog updates.
